name: model-router
description: Picks Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable for each subagent and shows what it cost.

baseline.title: Compare against
baseline.description: What the Unrouted column prices tokens on. unrouted: the model each agent would have used without the router.

routeAll.title: Route every subagent
routeAll.description: Off: route only the four router agents.

respectExplicitModel.title: Keep a model Claude asked for
respectExplicitModel.description: Leave a model the Agent call names.

effortByTier.title: Lower effort for easy tasks
effortByTier.description: Easy tasks run at low effort, normal at medium at most. Never raised.

riskFloor.title: Send risky tasks to Opus
riskFloor.description: Run tasks that could do lasting harm (deploy, delete data, force-push) on Opus or higher.

rescue.title: Move up a struggling agent
rescue.description: Move a stuck Haiku or Sonnet agent up one model mid-run.

limitPressure.title: Route cheaper near rate limits
limitPressure.description: At this share of a rate-limit window, route one tier cheaper. off: ignore limits.
